name: momentarr
description: Caching, serialising proxy for FlareSolverr-compatible Cloudflare solvers. Point Prowlarr/Jackett at momentarr instead of the solver: repeat requests to a solved site are served from the cached cf_clearance cookie over plain HTTP (~0.1s, no browser), and solves run one at a time so browsers never stack. Needs a solver alongside it: install Byparr or FlareSolverr and set Backend URL to it. Both must share the same outgoing IP (same host, or both behind the same VPN container).

ports.name: Port
ports.description: FlareSolverr API port. Use http:// :8191/ as the FlareSolverr proxy host in Prowlarr.

variables.name: Backend URL
variables.description: URL of the real solver (Byparr or FlareSolverr).

variables.name: Backend concurrency
variables.description: Solves in flight at once. 1 keeps a single browser.

variables.name: Cookie TTL (hours)
variables.description: Upper bound for cached clearances; the cookie's own expiry wins if sooner.
